title: Cut The Adrenaline Before Bed
hook: Something you do near bedtime might be spiking your heart rate and adrenaline and hurting your sleep without you realizing it.
body: For me it was driving fast late at night. I used to drop a girlfriend off around 11 or 11:30 at night in my Tesla Model 3 Performance, empty roads, and I'd have fun with it, going 120. When I got the Oura Ring I found out that late-night, adrenaline-filled driving was severely disrupting my sleep. Now I put it in Full Self-Driving, let the car drive me home, relax and listen to a boring podcast to wind down, and my sleep has gotten a lot better since I cut out the fast driving.
